title: External inventory allocation reserve request
description: Synchronous finished-goods reservation requested by the external sales platform. The provider selects the lots; the consumer never supplies an ops-core lot balance identifier.
$comment: OWNER-DIRECTIVE-2026-09-05-EXT-ALLOC-RESERVE (option A). This is the only external write surface; every other /v1 operation stays read/check-only under EXT-OD-07. Identity rules follow EXT-OD-02: source_object_id is the consumer-owned UUID and is stored verbatim. UOM rules follow EXT-OD-03: exact case-sensitive code, no conversion, no mixed-UOM aggregation, full-fill only.

warehouse_id.description: Exact accessible ACTIVE warehouse UUID. There is no fallback to another warehouse.

uom_code.description: Required case-sensitive ACTIVE approved sell/trade-item finished-goods UOM code. No case folding, conversion, or mixed-UOM aggregation is allowed.

requested_quantity.description: Positive decimal string with numeric(18,3) precision. Reservation is full-fill only; a shortage reserves nothing.

source_object_type.description: SHIPMENT_REFERENCE is an internal allocation source and is rejected on this route.

source_object_id.description: Consumer-owned order or order-line UUID stored verbatim. The provider never synthesizes it from the order header, SKU, ordinal, hash, or allocation ID.

source_object_no.description: Human-readable reference such as ORD-20260905-001/LINE-001. Display and reconciliation only; never an identity key.

expires_at.description: Optional UTC hold expiry. Must be after trusted server time. Omission holds until confirmed or released by warehouse operations.
